milestones.title: Map the extension, relay and hub event inventory to release tests and permitted deployment log samples
Relay log retention and forwarding in the operator runbook
Guidance on what the extension records, where and for how long

remediation: Extension, relay and hub maintainers publish the event inventory, map tested event generation and provide a supported forwarding option for required logs. The deployment operator approves the required event list and verifies representative events arrive at the configured log destination, are retained for the approved period, and can be retrieved for review.
title: Deployment audit event coverage, forwarding and retention need evidence
